   1 class_name CombatSystem extends System
   2 
   3 @export var runtime: Node = null
   4 
   5 func setup() -> void:
   6 	assert(is_instance_valid(runtime))
   7 
   8 func query() -> QueryBuilder:
   9 	return q.with_all([C_Combat, C_Input, C_Transform]).enabled()
  10 
  11 func process(entities: Array[Entity], _components: Array, delta: float) -> void:
  12 	for entity in entities:
  13 		if not entity.enabled:
  14 			continue
  15 		var combat: C_Combat = entity.get_component(C_Combat)
  16 		var input: C_Input = entity.get_component(C_Input)
  17 		var health: C_Health = entity.get_component(C_Health)
  18 		combat.sword_cooldown = maxf(0.0, combat.sword_cooldown - delta)
  19 		combat.card_cooldown = maxf(0.0, combat.card_cooldown - delta)
  20 		combat.dodge_cooldown = maxf(0.0, combat.dodge_cooldown - delta)
  21 		combat.energy = clampf(combat.energy + combat.energy_regen * delta, 0.0, combat.max_energy)
  22 		combat.dodge_invulnerable = false
  23 		if health != null and (health.dead or (health.hurt_left > 0.0 and entity.get_component(C_Boss) == null)):
  24 			combat.state = "idle"
  25 			combat.time_left = 0.0
  26 			combat.requested_attack = ""
  27 			continue
  28 		combat.time_left = maxf(0.0, combat.time_left - delta)
  29 		if combat.state != "idle":
  30 			if combat.state == "dodge":
  31 				combat.dodge_invulnerable = combat.time_left > 0.04
  32 			if combat.time_left <= 0.0:
  33 				match combat.state:
  34 					"boss_fan_windup", "boss_slam_windup":
  35 						_boss_attack(entity, combat, combat.state == "boss_slam_windup")
  36 						combat.state = "boss_recovery"
  37 						combat.time_left = 0.35
  38 					"sword_windup":
  39 						_sword(entity, combat)
  40 						combat.state = "sword_active"
  41 						combat.time_left = 0.14
  42 					"cast_windup":
  43 						_card(entity)
  44 						combat.state = "cast_recovery"
  45 						combat.time_left = 0.24
  46 					"sword_active":
  47 						combat.state = "sword_recovery"
  48 						combat.time_left = 0.16
  49 					_:
  50 						combat.state = "idle"
  51 			continue
  52 		var requested: String = combat.requested_attack
  53 		combat.requested_attack = ""
  54 		if requested in ["boss_fan", "boss_slam"] and entity.get_component(C_Boss) != null:
  55 			combat.state = requested + "_windup"
  56 			combat.time_left = 0.35
  57 			combat.attack_serial += 1
  58 		elif input.dodge_pressed and combat.dodge_cooldown <= 0.0 and input.source == "player":
  59 			combat.state = "dodge"
  60 			combat.time_left = 0.22
  61 			combat.dodge_cooldown = 0.85
  62 			combat.dodge_invulnerable = true
  63 		elif (input.sword_pressed or requested == "sword") and combat.sword_cooldown <= 0.0:
  64 			combat.state = "sword_windup"
  65 			combat.time_left = 0.1
  66 			combat.sword_cooldown = 0.42
  67 			combat.attack_serial += 1
  68 		elif (input.card_pressed or requested == "card") and combat.card_cooldown <= 0.0 and combat.energy >= combat.card_cost:
  69 			combat.state = "cast_windup"
  70 			combat.time_left = 0.12
  71 			combat.card_cooldown = 0.46
  72 			combat.energy -= combat.card_cost
  73 			combat.attack_serial += 1
  74 
  75 func _sword(entity: Entity, combat: C_Combat) -> void:
  76 	var motion: C_Motion = entity.get_component(C_Motion)
  77 	var health: C_Health = entity.get_component(C_Health)
  78 	var ai: C_EnemyAI = entity.get_component(C_EnemyAI)
  79 	var offset := Vector2(54 * motion.facing, -48)
  80 	var size := Vector2(100, 76)
  81 	if ai != null and ai.kind == "flying":
  82 		offset = Vector2(24 * motion.facing, 0)
  83 		size = Vector2(72, 70)
  84 	var position: Vector2 = entity.get_component(C_Transform).position
  85 	var room_id: String = entity.get_component(C_RoomMember).room_id
  86 	runtime.request_spawn("hitbox", room_id, {"position": position + offset, "owner_id": entity.id, "team": health.team, "attack_serial": combat.attack_serial, "offset": offset, "size": size, "damage": 25 if health.team == "player" else 12, "active_left": 0.14})
  87 	runtime.request_spawn("effect", room_id, {"kind": "slash", "position": position + offset, "size": size, "duration": 0.2, "color": Color(1, 0.8, 0.45) if health.team == "player" else Color(1, 0.25, 0.42), "owner_id": entity.id})
  88 
  89 func _card(entity: Entity) -> void:
  90 	var motion: C_Motion = entity.get_component(C_Motion)
  91 	var health: C_Health = entity.get_component(C_Health)
  92 	var position: Vector2 = entity.get_component(C_Transform).position + Vector2(30 * motion.facing, -48)
  93 	runtime.request_spawn("projectile", entity.get_component(C_RoomMember).room_id, {"position": position, "owner_id": entity.id, "team": health.team, "direction": Vector2(motion.facing, 0), "speed": 660.0 if health.team == "player" else 320.0, "damage": 20 if health.team == "player" else 10})
  94 
  95 func _boss_attack(entity: Entity, combat: C_Combat, slam: bool) -> void:
  96 	var boss: C_Boss = entity.get_component(C_Boss)
  97 	if not boss.arena_active or runtime.session.room_id != "house_throne" or runtime.session.mode != "playing":
  98 		return
  99 	if slam:
 100 		runtime.request_spawn("hitbox", "house_throne", {"position": boss.slam_center, "owner_id": entity.id, "team": "enemy", "attack_serial": combat.attack_serial, "size": Vector2(220, 56), "damage": 22, "active_left": 0.18, "follows_owner": false})
 101 		runtime.request_spawn("effect", "house_throne", {"position": boss.slam_center, "kind": "impact", "duration": 0.3, "size": Vector2(220, 56), "color": Color(1.0, 0.3, 0.65), "owner_id": entity.id})
 102 	else:
 103 		var motion: C_Motion = entity.get_component(C_Motion)
 104 		var origin: Vector2 = entity.get_component(C_Transform).position + Vector2(85 * motion.facing, -65)
 105 		var count: int = 3 if boss.phase == 1 else 5
 106 		for index in count:
 107 			var angle: float = (float(index) - float(count - 1) * 0.5) * 0.21
 108 			var direction := Vector2(motion.facing, 0).rotated(angle)
 109 			runtime.request_spawn("projectile", "house_throne", {"position": origin, "owner_id": entity.id, "team": "enemy", "direction": direction, "speed": 270.0 if boss.phase == 1 else 350.0, "damage": 12, "remaining": 4.5})
